title: Extract formatLogLine from the logger middleware
task: Refactor src/middleware/logger.js: extract the log-line formatting into a pure function formatLogLine(req, res, ms) that returns the string the middleware currently logs ("<method> <originalUrl> <statusCode> <ms>ms"), and have the middleware call it. Export formatLogLine as a named property on the same module (module.exports.formatLogLine) while keeping the middleware function as the module's default export so existing require('./middleware/logger') callers are unchanged. Behaviour must not change and no other file should be modified.
